# AI Verdict

AI Verdict helps companies automate legal business processes and connect them with existing operational systems. The core specialization is legal function automation: contracts, legal intake, litigation preparation, compliance, knowledge bases, templates, deadlines, approvals, and legal analytics.

The platform also designs and launches related automation when it is needed for the result or for another business goal: Telegram bots, websites, Mini Apps, internal tools, AI modules, dashboards, integrations with CRM, ERP, 1C, EDI, spreadsheets, databases, and other business systems.

## Positioning

AI Verdict starts with the legal process and measurable business result, then selects the right technical contour: AI module, workflow automation, integration, bot, website, Mini App, internal service, dashboard, or other software.
